chunks: Ahmad narrated from al-Hajjaj, from al-'Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)
Regarding the woman who prays near the man, he said: 'If there is a barrier between them, there is no harm.'
Regarding the woman who prs near the man, he said: 'If there is a barrier between them, there is no harm.'
ai.seo_question: What is the condition for a woman to pray near a man according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the conditions for the validity of a woman praying in the presence of a man, emphasizing that the presence of a physical barrier (hajib) renders the arrangement permissible. In Shia fiqh, this ruling is often discussed in the context of congregational prayer (Salat al-Jama'ah) or general proximity, highlighting that the barrier serves to maintain modesty and prevent distraction, thereby preserving the spiritual integrity of the prayer.
